191	function pathToParamNames(path: string): { re: RegExp; paramNames: string[] } {
192	  const paramNames: string[] = [];
193	  const pattern = path
194	    .replace(/[$()*+.?[\\\]^{|}]/g, "\\$&")
195	    .replace(/:([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)/g, (_match, name: string) => {
196	      paramNames.push(name);
197	      return "([^/]+)";
198	    });
199	  return { re: new RegExp(`^${pattern}$`), paramNames };
200	}
